recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-41762 unless a later work-group decision changes valueAlternatives semantics; FHIR-41763 should remain tracked in the FHIR Extension Pack context rather than as a core source edit.
issue_request: FHIR-41762 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for R6 asking to prepend text to ElementDefinition.valueAlternatives comments: when valueAlternatives is present, a present element SHALL have either a value or at least one listed extension, and valueAlternatives is only permitted on primitive types. It also asked to capitalize the existing first sentence's initial If.
initial_application: Commit 6fa4c9396db0e17a0d2b9c5ead53bf9f50ae263c, titled "FHIR-41762 Clarify expectations for valueAlternatives", appears to be the Jira-tagged application. The current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml comment for ElementDefinition.valueAlternatives contains the requested capitalized sentence and the requested SHALL/primitive-type clarification.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active datatype and normative artifact, confirming the inspected spreadsheet source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-03-18 record a motion to accept FHIR-41762 11-0-1 and summarize the same value-or-listed-extension expectation. The related FHIR-41763 issue defines a preferredValueAlternatives extension in the FHIR Extension Pack and does not require an additional core source change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current FHIR-core source already implements the requested clarification and no conflicting later Jira, Zulip, Confluence, source, or git evidence was found in the bounded investigation.
